question: Which river of India drains into Bay of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Godavari river **is the **second-longest river **in India, stretching over **1,450 km.**
 
• It originates in the **Western Ghats of Maharashtra **and flows through the states of** Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Odisha** before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The **Godavari river basin** is one of the most agriculturally productive regions in India, supporting a large number of crops such as** rice, sugarcane, and cotton.**
 
• The river is also an important source of water for **irrigation, hydroelectric power generation, and fishing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tapi river:**

 
 
• It is a river in central India that flows through the states of **Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh** before emptying into the Arabian Sea. 
 
 
 
• **Narmada river:**
 
 
• It is a **west-central Indian **river that flows through the states of **Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat **before emptying into the Arabian Sea.
 
 
 
• **Mahi river:**
 
 
• It is a river in western India that flows through the states of** Gujarat and Rajasthan** before emptying into the** Arabian Sea.**
